## Assignment Options

::: {.callout-note title="Mechanics Focus"}
The base assignment isolates transverse vertical loading, bearing reactions, shear force, and bending moment. Torsion, shaft sizing, bending stress, fatigue, dynamics, and local hub or keyway effects are intentionally excluded.
:::
